lead_raw_text:
The structure of Er3Al3Ir3 (ErAlIr) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R3m (No. 143), with 9 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al and Ir each adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors, while Er has 16 neighbors; the periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and face-sharing between Al and Ir 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Er and both Al and Ir polyhedra.
